- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cherry blossoms might be gone in May, but the weather is usually mild and comfortable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tokyo has two major airports: Narita International Airport (NRT) and Haneda Airport (HND).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] From Narita International Airport (NRT), the Narita Express (N'EX) takes around 60-70 minutes and costs ¥3,000-4,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Keisei Skyliner takes around 45 minutes to Ueno Station and costs ¥2,500.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Airport Limousine buses from Narita to various locations in Tokyo take around 60-90 minutes and cost ¥2,000-3,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxis from Narita to the city center cost around ¥15,000-20,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] From Haneda Airport (HND), the Tokyo Monorail takes around 15-20 minutes to Hamamatsucho Station and costs ¥500-1,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Keikyu Railway takes around 15-20 minutes to Shinbashi Station and costs ¥500-1,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Airport Limousine buses from Haneda to various locations in Tokyo take around 30-60 minutes and cost ¥1,000-2,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxis from Haneda to the city center cost around ¥6,000-10,000.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flight schedules and frequencies can vary greatly depending on the route, airline, and time of year.
